test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the sentence parts to form a logical sentence:

P: under international law

Q: Recognition of indigenous land rights

R: enhances environmental stewardship

S: and upholds cultural sovereignty
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **QRSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with **Q:** "Recognition of indigenous land rights," which introduces the subject clearly.
 
• The next part is **R:** "enhances environmental stewardship," which logically follows and explains the benefits of recognition.
 
• **S:** "and upholds cultural sovereignty" comes next to elaborate on another key benefit of recognizing indigenous land rights.
 
• The sentence ends with **P:** "under international law," which ties the statement to the legal framework.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QRSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (QSRP):** This sequence disrupts the logical flow by placing "and upholds cultural sovereignty" before "enhances environmental stewardship," making it less coherent.
 
• **Option 2 (RSQP):** This option starts with "enhances environmental stewardship," which is incomplete as it lacks an introduction to the subject of indigenous land rights.
 
• **Option 4 (PQRS):** This sequence starts with "under international law," which makes the sentence grammatically and contextually awkward without an initial subject.
